trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies. Keep cheats off the whole run: cheats disable trophy tracking and saving.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (200 hours, 4/10)
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1)
Clear the stranger chains (Stage 2)
Work the activities and robberies (Stages 3–4)
Finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road — the platinum follows

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own — it pops right after Chapter 1's first main mission, Gone Fishing. Just keep playing the story; there is nothing to miss here.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (first mission, Chapter 1)
steps: Play Chapter 1 until the mission Gone Fishing ends

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway: there is no mission replay, and you have 15 manual slots.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 1)
steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 2

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own when Chapter 2 ends — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also when switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, which several later trophies need.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 2)
steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 3

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own when Chapter 3 ends — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner and Randy's car list open up.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 3)
steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own when Chapter 4 ends, after the final main mission Starting From Zero. Save before that final mission: it is the last story beat before free-roam cleanup begins.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 4, final mission Starting From Zero)
steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4
Keep a manual save before the final mission

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own when the final mission, Starting From Zero, is complete. After it, the game returns you to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (final mission)
steps: Complete the final mission Starting From Zero
After the credits, open Progress > Stats to see the 100% checklist

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 2 mission)
steps: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run to the end

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 3 mission)

PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 4 mission)
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners to the end

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Chapter 5 mission)
steps: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory to the end

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts. Nothing toward it is missable, and everything can be done in free-roam after the story.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (100% checklist thresholds)
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist
Do optional missions as they appear (100 needed, there are 200–300+)
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles with WAiNK; study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars
Complete 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts
Clear the robberies, drone races, shooting ranges and Bret's quests the checklist demands

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — mix them freely, and flying under bridges is the quickest kind. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (250 of 397; categories; under bridges quickest)
steps: Open the map: Exploration > Stunt Spots to see found stunts
Start with Under the Bridges — the fastest category
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps to reach 250
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for the running total

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The tracker counts fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. View them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon). Most come naturally while working on the other trophies, so don't chase this one early.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (9 activity types)
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types
Do the ones the story hasn't introduced yet (golf, pool, basketball, arcade)
Win any race and perform any stunt to tick the last two

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.target: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread over 12 range locations. The gold medals aren't too difficult, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which the Gunslinger trophy needs. PowerPyx lists all 12 locations and the 42 golds in its shooting range guide.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (12 locations, 42 golds)
steps: Find a shooting range (12 locations across Leonida)
Play each challenge until gold — repeat the ones you miss
Use range practice to level Focus for Gunslinger

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.target: Win at all 14 drone race locations (42 races)
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations in its drone race guide.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (14 locations, 42 races)
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location
Win one race at each of the 14 locations
Save the harder locations for after you've practiced the drone handling

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, and the 100% checklist wants 30, so this pops on the way to that. Any race type counts — car races, race challenges and drone races all feed the same habit.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (40 unique race locations)
steps: Find race locations on the map (40 in total)
Win 20 different ones — repeats of the same race don't count
Keep going to 30 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.target: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the challenge. Fishing also counts toward the Master of None activity set.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Cal's questline after Feng Shui)
steps: Finish Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple map icon
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.target: Finish all levels of any 1 of 4 arcade games
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits at arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of the game once — beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick the one you like best.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (4 games; finish all levels)
steps: Go to the TV at home (or an arcade machine for Bang For Your Buck)
Pick any of the 4 games
Play through every level to the end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. PowerPyx says the quests stay available after the story, but start the chain when it unlocks to be safe: one guide warns stranger chains can have windows tied to story progress.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Andy's 5 quests, Chapter 3, Lucia only)
CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies, 19 Nov 2026 (stranger-chain window warning, single source)
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy calls
Follow her text to Belville
Complete all 5 Andy quests in order

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission Island Dreams he calls, and the green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chests on the map — dive to the shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3, so don't panic if he vanishes.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (7 shipwrecks; Key Lento; returns in Chapters 2–3)
steps: Finish Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams
Follow the KR icon in Key Lento
Dive each marked shipwreck and return the treasure
Keep answering Kenton's calls until all 7 wrecks are cleared

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of it stays available after the story, but start it when it unlocks to be safe.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Billy's 5 quests, after Coffee Break)
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County
Complete all 5 Billy quests in order

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers found in the open world. Only certain questlines count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy. Every strand stays available after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (confirmed strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete)
steps: Find stranger icons in the open world after the story
Finish Kirk's Skunk Ape chain (Search for the Skunk Ape, Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics)
Finish Kyle's farm chain and Yago's racing chain
Finish Pilot Pete's delivery chain — 8 strands total pops the trophy

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.target: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner for high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List — scan cars with WAiNK to check if one is wanted, then drive it back in good condition for more pay. Cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. It all stays doable after the story.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (16 cars; Key Cloner; Wish List tracking)
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List to see the 16 cars
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to spot wanted ones
Deliver each car to Randy's garage in good condition

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.target: Shut down the Synthetic Labs, then finish Spin On This
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Jason only; Synthetic Labs; two quests)
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty
Destroy the marked Synthetic Labs (Take Out Kitty Litter)
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, and finish it

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts double. Do the Chapter 1 one first: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony at Jason's house — follow her, choose Accept, and she teaches you to meditate. That balcony meditation vanishes after Chapter 1, and whether it is required is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (18 spots; Chapter 1 balcony meditation, possibly missable)
GTABase via CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies, 19 Nov 2026 (same warning)
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning
Follow her to the balcony, choose Accept, meditate with her
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can play both characters together
Visit all 18 spots, meditating as both Jason and Lucia at each

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: a text from Bret marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed, so work through his whole chain. His 15 Target Decks are all needed for the 100% checklist anyway.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Bret's chain; Killtelligence SM-69; animal unconfirmed)
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break
Answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted)
Hunt each animal he marks and bring it back
Work the full chain — the unlocking animal is still unconfirmed

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants all 15 sets it counts, so this silver pops early on the way to that. PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations in its collectible card guide.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (18 card sets)
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore
Complete any 3 full sets
Keep collecting — the 100% checklist wants 15 sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan any 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and flusher tags are out there, far more than 100. Hold Up and R1 to scan whatever you look at. It doesn't matter which 100 you pick, and the 100% checklist wants the same 100, so this and the checklist goal are one job.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures)
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan)
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you travel
Any 100 scanned locations pops the trophy

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges — most complete naturally while working on the other trophies, so save this for late and then pick the easiest ones left.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (80 challenges; 70 for 100%)
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see what's done
Let most complete naturally during other trophies
Late in the run, pick the easiest unfinished challenges until 50 are done

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.target: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. The easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you. It also pops naturally during the big bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (train tunnel north of Ambrosia; pops during bank robberies)
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle)
Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars
Ride a fast motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia
Drive out of the red heat zone — the trophy pops on exit

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.target: Rob 3 shops in a row, staying wanted, with your partner
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. It opens after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. The best spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it doesn't come, hit a fourth.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (3 jewelry stores, north Vice City; delayed pop)
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner; stock vest, sticky bombs, healing
Rob the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City in a row
Stay wanted between shops — don't lose the cops
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it hasn't popped

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 at launch, and scanning is enough — you don't need to drive them. Open WAiNK (hold Up), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; standing on a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the fastest way. The 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (557 vehicles; scan, don't drive; 200 for 100%)
steps: Open WAiNK with hold Up
Stand by a busy road and scan passing vehicles (hold R1)
Scan 100 unique vehicles — driving them is not needed

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots light up). It only lasts a few seconds, so prepare: eat, drink or wash up to buff focus, and pop Adrenaline to stretch it. Line up 5 gang members at a Gang Operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556 and don't miss. It doesn't seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus level 4 this gets much easier.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (L3+R3; Duke 556; gang members count)
steps: Buff focus: eat/drink, wash up, carry Adrenaline
Go to a Gang Operation with an assault rifle and body armor
Aim, trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3), take down 5 gang members fast
If it fails, level Focus to 4 first via shooting ranges and golf

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.target: Steal a docked jet at VCIA and fly 1 km away
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (terminals E3/E4; fly 1 km)
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through a fence to the departure terminals
Board the jet docked at E3/E4 via the stairs by the bridge
Enter the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off
Fly 1 km away from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.target: Steal a Rhino tank and fight from it
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a 3-star wanted level on the way out.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Mile Zero Air Station; south of the base)
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south-west Mariana County
Enter via the gate or the stunt jump at the south-east entrance
Climb into a Rhino tank in the south of the base
Shoot enemies from the tank until it pops

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.target: Silent jewelry robbery: Snap Gun, safe code, no alarm
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Break in through a back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and empty the safe without being spotted. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (Snap Gun; safe code; Richardson Jewelry)
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
Pick a jewelry store (green icon) — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a good one
Use the Snap Gun on the back door, never kick it
Find the safe code note, open the safe, leave unseen

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe) — it teaches bank vault robberies. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in fast and rob it; bring your partner, since you can't carry all the cash alone. Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) once his two Payday Loans jobs are done. Robbing a vault instantly gives 4 stars, so escape on a fast motorcycle. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist wants all 8 — this silver pops at 5, with up to $205,000 per bank.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (That's Where The Money Is…; Yasmani tips $10,000; 8 vaults)
steps: Finish Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
Tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open
Hand a bag to your partner (hold Right) and escape on a fast bike
Buy Yasmani's van tips and repeat until 5 vaults are robbed

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.target: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults — That's Where The Money Is… — also unlocks this one: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done.

trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation to blow the safe. Inside: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police — and it is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Max Strength for Jason AND Lucia at the same time
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and while one character works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). There are fitness clubs all over Vice City, and you can work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.target: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the trophy list itself shows the running count. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile), and a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy, clean), Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far: cops get far more aggressive. It comes naturally through robberies and fights; if it is the last trophy left, farming it means running over civilians and cops, which pushes the profile toward the permanent end, so finish it before you care about police heat.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026 (500 actions; Irredeemable is permanent)
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD)
Play normally — robberies and fights count toward 500
Watch the count on the trophy itself
Avoid Irredeemable: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew and unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so it comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist.

Rob banks and Payday Loans for Marked Bills
Bring the bills to Yasmani in Vice City
Repeat until $250,000 is laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, since they are the most expensive. Leonida has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — spending comes naturally across a full playthrough, and the robbery money from Dime on the Dollar funds it.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

steps: Buy guns and ammo at Ammu-Nation

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses and the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone; buy them through that app. The 4 story garages don't count. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the quick way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each one adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
